span.normalized: •On March 28, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement with RGLD Gold AG ("RG AG"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Royal Gold, Inc., that effectively extended the gold delivery threshold under the existing precious metals purchase agreement dated June 29, 2021 (the "Original Xavantina Stream") from 93,000 to 160,000 ounces before the stream percentage decreases from 25% to 10% of gold produced over the remaining life of mine (the "Stream Supplement"). In exchange, the Company received $50 million in upfront cash, bringing total proceeds under the Original Xavantina Stream and the Stream Supplement to $160 million (collectively, the “NX Gold Stream Agreements”).
